purpose: Provide a streaming, sparse, fail-closed retained-parent input boundary for the already frozen HARM-Delta mechanism without opening the active HORIZON scientific output or changing HARM arithmetic.

dependencies.required_evidence: The exact source-binding digest and every bound source artifact must verify before the ABI imports the HARM-Delta core or callback adapter.
Two byte-identical restricted tapes and their full TapeBinding metadata must be supplied; positional predictive records remain forbidden.
Two byte-identical HSP1 streams must contain exactly one eight-Q16 row for every HARM predictive coordinate encountered during state-warm replay and no other rows.
The distant scope requires two byte-identical HGS1 streams binding target, causal source, context hash, transition witness, observer identity, and terminal transition state.

contract.scientific_boundary: This ABI changes no route, donor, edit, mixture, control, population, threshold, or update rule. It supplies inputs to HARM-Delta and grants zero gain, archive, native-integration, or objective credit.

hsp1.record: little-endian uint64 WRT coordinate followed by eight little-endian uint16 Endpoint428 pretruth P1 counts in MSB-first truth-bit order
hsp1.probability_domain: Every count is in [1,65535]. Coordinates are strictly increasing, unique, inside the declared replay interval, and cover the callback adapter's parent requests exactly.
hsp1.streaming_rule: The provider advances monotonically with replay. A requested coordinate before or after the next record, a duplicate, an unused terminal record, a short record, or trailing bytes is fatal.

hgs1.record: little-endian uint64 target coordinate, source coordinate, exact 16-byte context hash, and rolling anchor-transition witness
hgs1.repeat_rule: A and B files, observer identities, payload hashes, target unions, and terminal transition hashes must match exactly.
hgs1.causal_rule: The frozen HARM callback adapter independently verifies age, exact historical context, context hash, and the complete already-decoded 512-byte donor before G can be admissible.

manifest.paths: Every input path is project-relative, regular, nonsymlinked, and bound by byte count plus SHA-256.
required_artifacts: HGS1 A and B for distant scope
manifest.coordinate_binding: The manifest binds raw, WRT, and coder-bit half-open scope bounds, state-warm replay bounds, raw and WRT population sizes, frontend state at both measurement boundaries, and Endpoint428 state at both replay boundaries.

scope_rules.fixture: Synthetic source-only validation; physical G may be absent and is inadmissible.
scope_rules.opening: Canonical raw [0,1000000); replay starts at WRT zero; physical G is absent and inadmissible.
scope_rules.distant: Canonical raw [500000000,510000000); replay starts at WRT zero; a nonempty repeated HGS1 input and admissible G are mandatory.

contract.repeat: Replay A uses the A route, parent, and physical streams. Replay B uses the separately materialized B streams. Scientific results and terminal HARM state must be identical.
contract.active_horizon_rule: Only bounded generated fixtures may execute while endpoint428_horizon_retained_parent_trace_q0_v1 is nonterminal. No active parent trace bytes, partial gains, controls, partitions, or scientific summaries may be read.
contract.future_execution_rule: A corpus-bound successor requires a new prospective experiment, a terminal HORIZON router decision, exact repeated route and sparse-parent inputs, a guarded output closure, and the original HARM opening/distant primary gates.

source_fixture_gate.population: Eight generated WRT bytes with six explicit-field predictive coordinates and no corpus access.
required_passes: HARM source binding and all bound artifacts verify
valid A and B manifests replay identically
sparse parent records cover all six and only the six predictive coordinates
E wakes on the second completed-route occurrence
opening-style absence of HGS1 keeps G inadmissible
physical HGS1 source binding parses independently
all frozen negative corruptions are rejected
the result retains zero objective credit
